svg.title: Zenflow scheduler component diagram: Nest placement orchestration, frozen TypeScript fallback, delayed-reward loop and the Python bandit service
svg.text: Nest gathers → Python ranks → Nest applies and persists. Orange = placement call path · blue = feedback loop · red = degraded path
NestJS API process (crons run in the watcher)
create: preflight → INSERT TASK row → placeOrDiscard(place)
update: deadline change → re-place · first MOVE → feedback
SeriesService: materialised TASK series (N rows, one seriesId)
the only entry sessions/ uses · placeOnCreate
a TASK is never left unplaced: last resort
the only RNG: primaryPolicy 50/50 LinUCB vs heuristic
applies Python's moves: UPDATE start + SYSTEM_MOVE event
observation count, preference matrix, bandit (A, b)
no displacement · no A/B · response has
read by day-load, written by PythonPlacer,
only if the proposal was LinUCB and the layout matches
slot, horizon, recurrence, matrix-decay, reward, reminder
no I/O · no clock · `now` is a parameter
FastAPI · optional bearer token (+ _PREVIOUS for rotation)
one request = one placement event (a task, or one series)
single → one day window · series → series_day_windows (N buckets)
pairwise series → two full plans (heuristic, LinUCB)
update(A, b, x, reward) → new (A, b)
cold arm = ridge prior (A = I, b = 0)
scoring: context_vector · arms (6 bands) · slot · slot_score
NOT on the request path: reward.py, sync_conflicts.py
per member: outcome = PLACED · DISPLACED · ACCEPTED_CONFLICTS ·
+ start, moves[], heuristic / linucb picks, paramsVersion, timings
